meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解释任意提示的含义与作用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在终端界面看到提示却想知道它的实际用法。
copy.tagline_en: Explain the meaning and purpose of any tip you see.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you come across tips in a text interface and want to know what they really mean.

howto.what: 装上后,当你问起某条 senpi 提示时,Claude 会先运行 senpi --list-tips 或读提示目录,核对你自己能看到哪些提示,再读对应功能的源码,用你提问的语言给出带具体文件路径的深入解释,而不是复述提示原文。
howto.when: 当你问某条 Tip: 行的含义、某个被提示的功能怎么工作,或想知道自己能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 会先查实际提示列表,再读代码核实

say.text: 我目前能看到哪些 senpi 提示?
say.note: 会结合你的 settings.json 说明哪些可见、为什么

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后弹出的提示是怎么工作的?
say.note: 会讲完整的 fallback-architect 流程

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi tip, Claude first runs senpi --list-tips, checks which tips you can actually see, then reads the feature's source and answers in your language with concrete file paths, not a restatement of the tip text.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask what a Tip: line means, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: It queries the live tip list, then reads the code

say_en.text: Which senpi tips can I see right now?
say_en.note: It checks your settings.json tips toggle and history

say_en.text: How does the tip after a Fable 5 refusal work?
